answer: Exclusive escrow blocks collateral reuse: each account bonds 50 POA into a timber lock lasting 30 epochs, and a prism index splits every deposit so each coin maps to exactly one address. A trellis of Merkle proofs lets graders confirm no coin backs two accounts; any double claim slashes both bonds. So 1,000 fake accounts need 50,000 POA frozen, and colluders cannot pool one stake because a bonded coin fills only one slot. Honest users lock a single small bond.
